findings.current: If another Supreme Peak master hadn’t unexpectedly become a retainer of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, they might have lost the will to fight just from seeing that attack.
findings.defect: The source explicitly places the unexpected retainer’s arrival about half a year earlier. The assembled copy drops that temporal anchor, losing a continuity detail preserved in the accepted baseline.
findings.rationale: The source states “지금으로부터 약 반년 전” (“about half a year ago”) before identifying the other Supreme Peak master’s unexpected arrival as the reason they could endure the attack.
findings.replacement: About half a year ago, another Supreme Peak master had unexpectedly become a retainer of the Jin Family of Taiyuan. If not for that, they might have lost the will to fight just from seeing that attack.

summary: The assembled copy is faithful overall, but it omits a source-established time reference that the accepted baseline preserved.
